events.summary: The oppressed artisan class of Vodalia is granted the right to found a colony far from the Imperial government.
events.quote: the artisan class sought and was granted the right to start a new colony

events.summary: Empress Galina III flees her crumbling empire through a portal to Etlan Shiis, arriving by accident in 3307 AR.
events.quote: By accident, she arrived there in 3307 AR , more than 3000 years in the future.

events.summary: Galina III quickly takes over power, founding New Vodalia.
events.quote: She quickly took over power in the Founding of New Vodalia .

events.summary: A Lord of Atlantis brings Greensleeves to a drowned piece of the former college, where she learns of the Stone Brain's origins.
events.quote: where she learned of the Stone Brain 's origins
